content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Generic injectable and inhaled drugs and diagnostics, a pharmaceutical business rather than orthopedic devices sold to surgeons."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Bone growth stimulators, cartilage repair and pain devices sold to orthopedic surgeons, hospitals and clinics, matching the target's product lines."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Dental implants, aligners and orthodontics sold to dental professionals, a different specialty and customer base."},{"label":"C4","good":true,"reason":"Surgical instruments and orthopedic implants sold to hospitals and surgeons, though its core focus is neurosurgery and wound care."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Branded non-opioid injectable drugs and a nerve-pain device, a drug-led pain business rather than orthopedic devices."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Diversified mix of medical tapes, dental products and health information software and services, not orthopedic devices."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Sterilizers, surgical tables and contract sterilization services, equipment and services unlike orthopedic implants and devices."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Pneumatic compression devices for lymphedema sold to home health providers and patients, a different therapy and customer base."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Vascular access, interventional and anesthesia catheters and devices, mostly a different product line from orthopedic implants."},{"label":"C10","good":true,"reason":"Spine implants and bone graft products sold to spine surgeons and hospitals, close to the target's orthopedic implant business."}]}
